rv.q: Van Hove's brutalist concept may evoke the despicable Don but not the divine Mozart.
This season's production of "Don Giovanni" resonate beyond all expectations.
Green exceeded all expectations, and the production is even worse than remembered.

cn.t: Mozart's score and a stellar cast shine in this revival, but van Hove's brutal production concept divides critics, with some finding it evocative and others deeming it a distraction from the divine music.
